feedback:
ACCEPTED. The reward machine is semantically faithful, well-formed, and safe.

Semantic fidelity: The task is the conjunction 'exit while holding the box' AND 'after every fall, hold the box again on the very next move'. The machine encodes both: u0/u2/u4 reward (at_exit & holding_box) with 1.0, and u1/u3 are one-step adjudication states entered on the box_fell event; from them, holding_box on the next step yields the 0.1 pickup reward (u2/u4), while !holding_box sends the agent to the explicit failure sink u5, which correctly zeroes all future reward since the conjunctive task is then unsatisfiable. The tricky environment rules are handled correctly: a pickup on a due-fall step fires box_fell with holding_box false, which is caught by the box_fell guards (u2->u3), and a fall skipped while the hands are empty produces no event, so no next-move obligation is imposed (u2/u4 else self-loops). Voluntary drop/re-pick cycles are correctly not penalized, since only actual falls create the deadline and falls are capped at two.

Structural checks: FINAL_STATES header is present and nonempty (u6), u6 is declared in STATES and is the accepting success sink. All seven states are reachable from u0 and u6 is reachable on real trajectories (e.g., the reference trace scores 0.1 + 0.1 + 1.0 = 1.2). Guards within each state are mutually exclusive and exhaustive, so ordered transition coverage is unambiguous; every state has an else self-loop that absorbs the task-irrelevant siren_ringing and switch_toggled propositions, so siren activity never derails progress tracking. The persistent/event distinction is correct: box_fell is used only as an edge trigger, holding_box and at_exit as state conditions. Rewards are nonnegative, bounded (max total 1.2), and not farmable: the 0.1 pickup rewards can fire at most twice because only two falls can occur and re-picking after a voluntary drop cannot re-enter u1/u3.

Minor non-blocking notes: (1) Compactness - u0, u2, and u4 are behaviorally equivalent (and u1/u3 given that), since no third fall can occur, so the machine could be compressed to four states (holding, awaiting pickup, failure sink, success) without behavior change; the explicit unrolling is correct but not minimal. (2) The else self-loops of u1 and u3 are unreachable because their enumerated guards already partition the label space - cosmetic dead code. (3) (u0, at_exit & holding_box) -> u6 is unreachable in this layout (first fall fires by step 8 while the exit needs at least 10 moves), but it is a harmless and semantically correct safety guard.
